issues.what: the rise cover does not connect one move. A straight diagonal cloud band in 4407 becomes a curved limb in a different place in 4409. In 4408 both are visible at once as a crossfade, so it reads as two shots dissolved together, not one flight out
issues.fix: drive both sides of the cover from one continuous camera path so the band in the haze becomes the limb, and drop the crossfade

issues.what: exposure and color drop from bright teal haze to black space in about three frames, which reads as a pop instead of climbing out of the atmosphere
issues.fix: stretch the haze-to-vacuum falloff over 15-20 frames and ease the exposure change

issues.what: the Milky Way is missing in 4414-4420, then fills the upper left densely by 4427. At the same time the camera jumps from a limb at the bottom of the frame to a large three-quarter planet. Sky and framing both pop
issues.fix: keep the galaxy band in the sky all the way through the rise (dimmed by exposure if needed), and ease the pull-back so the scale changes steadily

issues.what: within 8 frames the view jumps from a dome on a black sky to a wide flat limb with a dense Milky Way across the top. The rings jump from upper left to the right side. This is a jump in direction and field of view during the dive
issues.fix: add an eased pitch-down over more frames, or check the camera keys for a discontinuity between 4142 and 4150

issues.what: the limb, sun and ring arcs stay locked in place while only the surface texture moves under them. There is no parallax between the near ground and the horizon, so it reads as a texture sliding, not flight over real terrain
issues.fix: add real camera translation and a slight drift in heading, so the near clouds move faster than the far limb and the horizon shifts slowly

issues.what: the bright sun flare and the ring hoops are gone within 6 frames. The sun turns into a faint point, so the start of the rise cover pops
issues.fix: fade the flare and rings together with the haze density over a longer, eased span

issues.where: frames 4415-4416, the bright star/sun point at right
issues.what: the point jumps about 17px upward in one frame while the horizon barely moves, so it is out of step with the camera
issues.fix: lock the point to the same sky transform as the starfield and horizon

issues.where: frames 4409-4416, right edge near the limb
issues.what: a thin grey horizontal sliver (ring fragment) sits right against the right edge of the frame and flickers in and out
issues.fix: either fully show the ring or keep it out of frame, and make sure it is not being clipped at the edge

issues.what: no rings in 4175, then fully drawn ring hoops in 4183, which reads as a pop-in when leaving the dive cover
issues.fix: fade the rings in as the haze clears

issues.what: dark blotchy noise in the blurred clouds changes shape from frame to frame, which reads as crawling noise rather than drifting cloud
issues.fix: raise samples or add temporal denoising on the cloud volume during the cover

issues.what: the fine ring strands run into the top edge of the frame and their thin parallel lines are at risk of shimmering
issues.fix: add a little blur or supersampling to the ring lines, and reframe so the arc is not clipped
